new.name: EP Micro Crab
new.description: A small crab with EP fibre claws, rubber legs and a body of wrapped streamer brush trimmed flat, on a weedguarded hook.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of tailing permit or redfish and let it settle.
mats: Tan EP streamer brush, trimmed flat
steps: Tie in the weed guard and eyes.
Tie in flash and EP fibre claws at the bend, then legs each side.
Wrap the brush forward and trim it flat and round like a crab shell.
Bring the weed guard forward and tie it off.

new.name: Kung Fu Crab
new.description: A crab with rabbit strip claws coated at the tips, an EP fibre body and lots of rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to permit and redfish; let it sink and twitch once.
mats: Tan rabbit strip, tips coated with UV resin
Tan and brown EP fibres, tied crosswise and trimmed
steps: Tie on the eyes so the fly rides hook up.
Tie in the rabbit claws at the bend.
Tie EP fibres across the shank in bunches and add legs.
Trim to a round crab body and coat the claw tips.

new.name: EP Fleeing Crab
new.description: A crab with a furry foam body glued over lead eyes, plastic crab eyes and velvet chenille legs, built to dive away like a fleeing crab.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it once and let it dive; permit eat it on the drop.
mats: EP crab claws or velvet chenille
steps: Tie on the lead eyes and weed guard.
Tie in the crab eyes and legs.
Glue the furry foam body over the top.

new.name: Flexo Crab
new.description: A permit crab of braided Flexo tubing and yarn with rubber legs and lead eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Cast ahead of cruising permit and let it fall.
mats: Flexo tubing and yarn, tied crosswise
steps: Tie on the eyes and claws.
Tie the body material across the shank.
Add legs and trim the body round.

new.name: Bauer Crab
new.description: A soft, weighted crab with a dubbed body, claws and legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for permit and bonefish.
steps: Build the body and add the legs.

new.name: Pink Puff
new.description: A pink chenille 'puff' head with bead chain eyes and a short wing: one of the first bonefish flies.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short pulls over light bottoms.
mats: Pink chenille, wrapped around the eyes
Grizzly hackle tips or craft fur
steps: Tie in a short wing hook-up.
Wrap chenille round the eyes for the puff head.

new.name: Bonefish Clouser
new.description: A small, sparse Clouser in tan or white with bead chain eyes for bonefish.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along the bottom in front of bonefish.
steps: Add flash and the tan back.

new.name: Horror Bonefish Fly
new.description: A simple bonefish fly with a tan bucktail wing and a chenille head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on clear sand flats.

new.name: Hamilton's Cuda Tube
new.description: A long, thin needlefish imitation on a tube for barracuda.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it as fast as you can; cuda love speed.
mats: Tube with a short-shank stinger hook
Long synthetic fibres, green over white

new.name: Needlefish Fly
new.description: A long, slim fly of synthetic fibres for barracuda.
new.fishing_tips: Rip it across the flat.
mats: Long green and white synthetic fibres
steps: Add eyes and coat the head.

new.name: Schminnow
new.description: A marabou tail and a pearl ice chenille body with mono eyes: a top snook and jack fly.

steps: Tie in the marabou tail and flash.
Wrap the chenille body round the eyes.

new.name: Dock Light Fly
new.description: A small, bright glass minnow fly for snook feeding under lit docks at night.
new.fishing_tips: Drift and twitch it through the light edge.

new.name: Redfish Crack
new.description: A weedless redfish fly with lead eyes, a soft tail and rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it in front of tailing redfish.
steps: Tie in the tail and legs.
Wrap the body and add a weed guard.

new.name: Skinny Water Seaducer
new.description: A light, weedless Seaducer for very shallow water.
new.fishing_tips: Plop it near redfish and snook in skinny water.

new.name: Redfish Gurgler
new.description: A foam-backed gurgler that spits water for redfish.
new.fishing_tips: Gurgle it over grass flats at dawn.
mats: Foam strip, folded forward into a lip
steps: Tie in the tail and foam.
Fold the foam over and leave a lip.

new.name: Redfish Shrimp
new.description: A simple shrimp for redfish and bonefish with weighted eyes and a brush body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short hops.
steps: Tie on the eyes and antennae.
Add legs and trim the shell flat.

new.name: Baltic Shrimp
new.description: A sea trout shrimp with a chartreuse thread base, a palmered body and a shellback, popular on the Baltic coast.

new.name: Tauntaun
new.description: A buggy crab/shrimp fly for black drum and redfish: raccoon tail, EP claws and eyes and a brush body.

Wrap the brush body with legs.

new.name: LaFleur Charlie
new.description: A pink Estaz Crazy Charlie with a pink craft fur wing and lead eyes.
new.fishing_tips: An all-round saltwater pattern for redfish, trout and bonefish.
steps: Tie in the wing hook-up and coat the head.

new.name: Bucktail Teaser
new.description: A blue and white bucktail teaser fished above a bucktail jig or alone for fluke and stripers.
new.fishing_tips: Bounce it along the bottom.
steps: Tie white bucktail under the shank.
Tie blue bucktail on top and coat the head.

new.name: Mossy Creek Fluke Fly

steps: Tie in the saddles as a tail.
Wrap the craft fur and flash brushes.

new.name: Andino Deceiver

new.name: Billfish Popper
new.description: A big foam-headed popper on a tube for sailfish and marlin.

new.name: Sailfish Tube Fly
new.description: A long tube fly of saddle hackles and flash for sailfish and marlin.

steps: Tie long saddles on the tube.
Finish the head and rig the hooks.

new.name: GT Brush Fly
new.description: A big, tough brush fly for giant trevally.

new.name: Schoolie Fly

Add eyes and coat the head.
